candidates.title: Terra Mystica
candidates.focus_fit: Terra Mystica is a competitive engine-building and area-control game whose deterministic development economy and reviewer-described blocking pressure fit the wishlist request.

coverage.methodology: Rules coverage counts the one official German core rulebook retrieved from the publisher and used for the bounded claims; expansions, variants, and an exhaustive FAQ/errata inventory remain outside scope. Factual coverage records sourced claim groups without manufacturing a denominator.
